name: ai-fruit-quality-detection-system
description: Root workspace - runs frontend and backend together

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
